- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a general rule of thumb for budget allocation: 30-40% for cabinets and countertops, 20-30% for appliances and plumbing fixtures, 15-25% for flooring and electrical updates, 10-20% for painting, trim work, and miscellaneous items, and 5-10% for unexpected expenses or contingencies.
